name: madlog-store-landing
_comment: Static landing page only. The Laravel admin app at /admin is not deployed on Vercel — it requires a PHP runtime + database and lives in the Laravel codebase, not on a static host. This config serves the self-contained index.html (already built, fully inlined CSS/JS/fonts) at /, with friendly rewrites so any stray URL falls back to the landing page rather than 404ing.
